manifest.title: Ames 非投票记录语义审查：需要修正机械筛选

blocks.body:
# Ames 非投票记录语义审查：需要修正机械筛选

2026-09-06 · TxAgent · 审查完成，候选尚未整合进活跃 gold

## 严格 gold 应落实到实验含义，而不是整段关键词

逐条审阅 144 条非投票记录后，发现 10 条可按现有条件词汇进入补充投票审核，另有 7 条需要更丰富的条件，1 条已由同一研究同条件的另一条记录投票。其余记录分别缺上下文/原研究，存在身份问题，或没有可用的直接实验结果。这里的候选数不是新增 vote 数，也不是可新增分子数。当前 gold、split 和 index 均未改变。

## 统计单位是原始记录，不是分子或独立实验

本次覆盖 96 条 ames_base 和其他三个 source 各 16 条，共 142 个 PMID、127 个非空 parent；133 条当前位于 L2，11 条是 audit-only。先按 15 类 base 排除原因、base 非 direct-family L2 和其他 run L2 抽取 120 条，再定向补充 24 条高优先级记录。原先的 91,511/334,211 = 27.4% 是原始 family 标记占比，不是人工审查后的保留率。

各层样本配额不等、追加样本刻意寻找 direct 信息；不能将下面比例外推为总体误删率。

## 有漏掉的候选，也有必须保留的排除

“needs_more_context=true”“weak_positive”“positive_control”“同时提到两种方法”都需要具体解释。它们有时掩盖明确实验，有时确实提示结果或条件不足。不能整体放开，也不能整体当作永久不合格。

## 明确实验被机制措辞、方法并列和用途标签挡下

- **AMP397（ames_base:68578）**：原始抽取报告五株在 +S9 下两种方法均阴性；当前规则因同时出现平板掺入和预培养而拦截。这是 +S9 条件的候选，不能概括为该分子总体 Ames 阴性。
- **1-nitropyrene-2-ol（ames_base:217918）**：+S9 的阳性明确；“possibly”修饰活性代谢物的位置，不是实验结果。当前已有 -S9 阴性票，两臂应分开。
- **4NQO / Trp-P-1（ames_base:22360 / 89734）**：给出了实测阳性对照回复菌落数；应与“只列为阳性对照、没有结果”的记录区别审核。
- **HEMF / AHTN（ames_base:245968 / 11149）**：前者明确 TA100-S9 阳性，后者报告七株 ±S9 阴性及有效阳性对照；上下文标志和沉淀说明应进入具体审核。

10 条现有条件候选中 6 条已有 source name-parent 核验，3 条名称未查，1 条来自没有 molecule_name 字段的其他 run。即使身份已核验，仍须按逐条要求核对结果表、条件与 study 去重。

## 原始文献核验支持部分恢复，也纠正了一个看似可直接投票的来源

PubMed 原始摘要确认了 1-nitropyrene-2-ol 的 +S9 阳性/-S9 阴性、HEMF 的 TA100-S9 阳性，以及 TNX 在 TA100+S9 的弱致突变且无观察到的细胞毒性。弱效力不能自动等同于 equivocal。AHTN 的摘要也报告了明确 strain panel 和 ±S9 下的 Ames 阴性。

paepalantine 的 ames_v1:45744 正文包含完整的三株 ±S9 阳性，但其 PMID15720259 是综述。已找到相应原研究 PMID9261922；恢复时必须追溯原实验，并按原研究去重，不能给综述单独增加一票。

## 跨 run 可以恢复直接结果，但必须重建目标 outcome

ames_v3:556955 的 `no_effect` 指 MNUA 致突变不依赖 lexA，并不意味着 Ames 阴性；正文说明它在 WP2 与 WP2 lexA 均诱发回复突变。可提出 WP2/-S9 阳性候选，但还需核验来源中的化合物名称映射和方法。其他记录的 positive/negative 可能属于染色体、DNA adduct 或 SOS reporter，不能直接搬成 Ames 标签。

一个合格 TA100+S9 描述（ames_base:277608）已有 ames_base:277613 代表同研究同条件投票。它应补充出处而不是新增票；L2 中有有效描述不必然代表漏掉独立实验。

## 特殊方法需要保留条件，不代表实验质量低

OECD 471 描述平板掺入、预培养等方法，并讨论气体/挥发性物质的测试与有科学理由的方法调整。方法名称本身不构成否定细菌回复突变的理由。我们构造的是指定条件下的文献结果，不应把它误称为每条都完成了完整监管测试组合。

## 当前 strain×S9 签名不能容纳所有真实实验差异

Crotonaldehyde 同一菌株在平板掺入为阴性、液体预培养为阳性；benzidine 在膀胱活化系统与肝活化系统不同。这样的记录不能机械排除为非 Ames，也不能去掉条件直接合成普通 +S9 票。气相暴露、光照/pH、特定酶/辅因子和基因型也需要在影响解释时保留。七条 richer-condition 候选是后续条件设计与审核输入，不是已发布的新 condition。

## 真正的非投票原因与本轮边界

49 条本窗口没有可用直接实验票，包括仅预测、仅方法或对照用途、不同终点、别的分子受影响，以及明确 equivocal/无法评价的结果；这不等于它们都没有检索价值。67 条仍需上下文或原始研究；10 条有身份/受试物问题，其中既有明确结构矛盾，也有需要图表才能确认的疑点。

这是 Codex 对完整 supplied records 的逐条语义阅读，并补查 15 篇 PubMed 元数据和摘要；不是人类专家标注，也不是 144 篇全文审查。原始抽取的语义错误、字段缺失和综述来源仍可能存在。未进行模型性能实验，也未估计全量可新增分子数。

## 下一次 gold 修订应同时检查纯度和遗漏

1. 从四个 source 统一形成 direct 审核队列；原始 run/family 和整段关键词只用于优先级与提示。
2. 逐条解析受试分子、实测 endpoint、结果、实验臂和 primary study；本轮的 10+7 条候选及 67 条待追溯记录保留明确后续要求。
3. 完成身份核验，跨 run 合并 PMID×parent×condition，解决同研究冲突；保留有条件 60%、无条件 70% agreement 与去 tie 规则。缺必要条件不能自动变成无条件样本。
4. 只有实际输出的 study-unit representative 进入 L1。未解决的 direct 相关记录仍限 L2，不能移入 L3–L5。
5. 重建 benchmark、split 和 heldout-filtered indices 后核验，再进行模型评估。

待解决的问题是可推广的语义审核规则、特殊条件表达和原文可获得性。当前纯度/泄漏检查通过，不代表 gold 覆盖已经完整。

## 每条记录都有结论与来源

下表列出全部 144 条。完整原始字段见 sample.jsonl；提议标签、条件、剩余核验要求和已有 study-vote 对照见 audit_annotations.jsonl；抽样与统计复现见 review.ipynb。

reviews.decision: 实验合格，但已有同研究同条件票
reviews.rationale: TA100 的括号是在解释菌株背景，不是第二个不明菌株；本文报告剂量相关阳性。现有 ames_base:277613 已覆盖同一 PMID-parent-TA100+S9，只能补来源，不能再加票。
reviews.support_text: In the mutagenicity assay toward Salmonella typhimurium TA100, dose-dependent mutagenic activity was observed for 1,3-dimethylbenzo[b]fluoranthene (1,3-diMeBbF); the other methylated BbF derivatives tested were inactive at the doses tested. Thus 1,3-diMeBbF was a mutagenic (positive) test substance.
reviews.extra_details: Dose-dependent mutagenic activity observed in the S. typhimurium TA100 assay (means of duplicate assays); S9 fraction from livers of male Fischer 344 rats treated with Aroclor-1254 (500 mg/kg). 1,3-diMeBbF (>99% pure) was also a strong tumor initiator with activity greater than BbF.
reviews.remaining_requirements: Already represented; attach supporting provenance instead of creating a second vote.

reviews.rationale: 综述中的 Ames 阳性总结，缺菌株和活化；触发比较词不是主要问题，需追原研究。
reviews.support_text: Among non-carcinogens/non-genotoxic carcinogens that were BSHC positive, no in vitro mammalian data were found for 4-Hydroxy-2,5-dimethyl-3(2H)furanone: it was Ames positive.
reviews.extra_details: Ames positive; no in vitro mammalian mutagenicity data found; BSHC positive only at concentrations exceeding 1 mM; also tested negative in a 2y carcinogenicity study and in a dominant lethal test in mouse.

reviews.rationale: 综述汇总多个菌株和大鼠/仓鼠 S9；结构化 panel 漏 TA97。需追原试验并核实完整 panel 与活化来源。
reviews.support_text: Genetic toxicity table for ethylene dibromide (CAS 106-93-4) in Salmonella Typhimurium TA strains: TA100 +/+, TA1535 +/+, TA97 -/-, TA98 +/+, where the first symbol is without and the second with S9. This shows positive Salmonella mutagenicity with and without S9 in TA100, TA1535, and TA98. Also positive in Drosophila SLRL/HT and mouse lymphoma TK (+/+).
reviews.extra_details: Ames mutagenic in TA100 (+/+), TA1535 (+/+), and TA98 (+/+) with and without S9; TA97 negative (-/-). Salmonella tests used S9 from Aroclor 1254-induced Sprague-Dawley rat and Syrian hamster liver.

reviews.rationale: 引用多篇实验且盐包含多个有机组分；不同文献的 S9 结论不同。不能把盐和多研究合成单个票。
reviews.support_text: Reverse bacterial mutagenesis studies with DMSO-solubilized pyrvinium pamoate by MacPhee and Podger (1977) and de la Iglesia et al. (1982) demonstrated unequivocal intrinsic frameshift and base-substitution activity in Salmonella strains TA98 and TA100 only in the presence of S9 fraction from Aroclor-1254 induced rat liver; Espinosa et al. (1981) reported similar findings and detected activity without metabolic activation.
reviews.extra_details: Promutagen: frameshift and base-substitution activity, DMSO-solubilized; activity observed only with S9 fraction from Aroclor-1254-induced rat liver (MacPhee & Podger 1977; de la Iglesia et al. 1982); Espinosa et al. 1981 reported detection of activity without metabolic activation.

reviews.decision: 需补充条件定义的候选
reviews.rationale: 确实报告本分子在 TA100 的弱致突变；human liver activation 是可表达的条件，不代表非 Ames。需保留人肝活化来源及弱结果判读。
reviews.support_text: In the Ames quantitative mutagenicity test using Salmonella typhimurium TA 100, a generally low mutagenic activity was observed in the capability of human liver enzymes to activate the polynuclear aromatic hydrocarbon 3-methylcholanthrene.
reviews.extra_details: Ames quantitative mutagenicity test; human liver post-mitochondrial supernatant (10 individuals) as activation source; tested at 10, 50 and 500 µg per plate; DMSO solvent.

reviews.rationale: 正文 BP 明确为 benzo[a]pyrene，SMILES 却是环状硅氧烷；身份拦截正确，不能因有 Ames 结果而放行。
reviews.support_text: For BP (benzo[a]pyrene), Tween 80 alone or formulated with the oils or liquid paraffin gave essentially the same results as in the absence of Tween 80, indicating BP mutagenicity was detected in the assay (consistent with the prior description that effects of oils on BP mutagenicity were determined as described for BA).
reviews.extra_details: BP (benzo[a]pyrene) mutagenicity determined in S. typhimurium TA98 with S9 mix; effects of oils/liquid paraffin/Tween 80 on its mutagenicity essentially unchanged versus no Tween 80 (data not shown).

reviews.decision: 本条不是可用的直接实验票
reviews.rationale: 只列阳性对照的用途与方法，没有该化合物实际结果；两种方法不是根本问题。
reviews.support_text: In the Ames test, positive controls in the absence of S9-mix were 4-nitro-1,2-phenylenediamine (NPD), sodium azide (SAZ), 9-aminoacridine (9AA) and methylmethanesulfonate (MMS); in the presence of S9-mix the positive control was 2-aminoanthracene (2AA) in the plate-incorporation and confirmatory pre-incubation experiments with S. typhimurium TA98, TA100, TA1535, TA1537 and E. coli WP2 uvrA.
reviews.extra_details: Designated Ames positive control in the absence of S9-mix; DMSO was the vehicle control. Plate incorporation and confirmatory pre-incubation procedures; revertant colonies counted manually after incubation at 37 °C for 48 h.

reviews.decision: 现有条件下的投票审核候选
reviews.rationale: 同一分子在五株、+S9 的平板掺入和预培养结果均无回复菌落增加；方法并列不造成标签冲突。-S9 的阳性不能覆盖本 +S9 阴性。
reviews.support_text: In the Ames test tables (plate incorporation and pre-incubation), AMP397 gave essentially no increase in revertant numbers across strains TA1535, TA97a, TA98, TA100, and TA102 in the presence of rat liver S9 up to 4400 µg/plate.
reviews.extra_details: No concentration-dependent revertant increase with S9 in plate incorporation or pre-incubation; precipitation of test compound noted at 4400 µg/plate in plate incorporation.
reviews.remaining_requirements: Review exact +S9 tables; permit concordant measured methods, preserve the distinct -S9 positive arm; current source identity is verified.

reviews.rationale: 液体预培养是直接回复突变，但该记录明确引用 Arni/Müller 1986；应追原研究而非算当前 PMID 的独立实验。
reviews.support_text: When a liquid incubation system was used, thioacetamide itself was also found to induce mutants with strains TA100 and TA1535 at concentrations of 90 µg/ml in the absence and in the presence of an S9 mixture (Arni and Müller, 1986).
reviews.extra_details: Mutant induction at 90 µg/ml both in the absence and in the presence of an S9 mixture.

reviews.rationale: 确有 hisC3108 回复突变；菌株是 SB1111，活化不明且无机物当前不投票。不是方法词就能决定无效。
reviews.support_text: Hydrogen peroxide reverted all the hisC3108 strains SB1111, SB1106, and SB1106p in both the SPI and PRE protocols. Strain SB1111, carrying only the hisC3108 mutation, gave a weak positive response without exhibiting toxic effects at the H₂O₂ concentrations used.
reviews.extra_details: Positive (though weak) in both SPI (plate incorporation) and PRE (preincubation?) protocols; no toxicity observed at the concentrations tested.

reviews.rationale: selenite 清除/加 cysteine 方法影响细胞毒性和反应物；需拆分处理臂并审核金属身份、活化、对照，不宜简单正负归并。
reviews.support_text: The mutagenicity of selenite was investigated using tester strain TA104 in the Salmonella mutagenicity assay. Because TA104 was very sensitive to killing in the standard plate incorporation procedure, a modified procedure (preincubation of TA104 with selenite for 20 min followed by treatment with cysteine, or removal of selenite by centrifugation) was used, and selenite was detected as a mutagen. A control in which cysteine was added before selenite, exposing cells to oxygen radicals produced by the reaction of selenite and cysteine without exposure to selenite alone, showed no significant mutagenic response.
reviews.extra_details: Spontaneous revertants per plate of 274 (plus cysteine) and 240 (minus cysteine) were subtracted. With the centrifugation-based removal procedure, toxicity appeared at a much lower selenite concentration, attributed to increased exposure time; shortening preincubation and centrifugation times shifted the maximal mutagenic response to a higher selenite concentration. The tester strain TA104 is used to detect oxidizing agents as mutagens.

reviews.decision: 需补充条件定义的候选
reviews.rationale: 同一 TA100 在平板掺入为阴性、液体预培养为阳性；必须把方法加入 condition，不能用当前 strain×S9 签名混成一票。
reviews.support_text: In the liquid-suspension method with 0.1 M phosphate buffer (pH 7.4) (Method B), crotonaldehyde showed a distinct dose-response relationship and was mutagenic for strain TA100 even in the absence of S9 mix. Method A (plate-incorporation) gave negative results both with and without S9 mix, but Method B gave positive results.
reviews.extra_details: Buffer (0.1 M phosphate, pH 7.4) liquid-suspension method, 90 min incubation at 37°C in closed tubes, 10 µl crotonaldehyde in DMSO added; mutagenic even without S9 mix. Optimal yield of about 1600 revertants per plate at a dosage of 0.1 µl crotonaldehyde per ml (without S9). With S9 mix a marked reduction of mutagenic potential was observed, correlating with other directly acting allylic mutagenic compounds. Means of three independent experiments, average deviation ≤15%.

reviews.decision: 本条不是可用的直接实验票
reviews.rationale: OTA 是一般性 mutagen 称谓且引用他文，没有本条 Ames 实验。
reviews.support_text: In the introduction, the authors state that, apart from nephrotoxic and carcinogenic effects, there is now evidence of hepatotoxic, teratogenic, mutagenic and immunosuppressive properties of the mycotoxin ochratoxin A (OTA), citing Petzinger and Ziegler (2000) and Walker (2002). This is a narrative mutagen designation for OTA rather than a specific assay result.
reviews.extra_details: General known-mutagen statement; OTA is additionally described as having nephrotoxic, carcinogenic, hepatotoxic, teratogenic and immunosuppressive properties, cited to Petzinger and Ziegler, 2000 and Walker, 2002. No specific mutation/chromosome assay or Ames result is described for OTA in this paper.

reviews.decision: 本条不是可用的直接实验票
reviews.rationale: Klebsiella 波动实验不属于当前 Salmonella/E. coli 氨基酸回复突变目标；还存在同位素结构需核实。
reviews.support_text: In the test battery of Kramers and colleagues, methyl bromide gave about a 6-fold increase in a fluctuation test with Klebsiella pneumoniae, indicating mutagenic activity in this bacterial fluctuation test.
reviews.extra_details: About 6-fold increase in the fluctuation test; Kramers et al., 1985.

reviews.decision: 本条不是可用的直接实验票
reviews.rationale: STZ 的胰岛细胞毒性/烷基化及 mutagen 称谓，不是本条细菌回复突变结果。
reviews.support_text: The text states that STZ (2-Deoxy-2-[(methylnitrosoamino)carbonyl]amino)-D-glucopyranose) is a DNA alkylating agent and mutagenic toxin for the pancreatic β-cells, leading to their damage and death (citing Lenzen, 2008a). This is an explicit designation of STZ as a mutagenic substance.
reviews.extra_details: STZ is described as a DNA alkylating agent and mutagenic toxin for pancreatic β-cells causing their damage and death; used to induce experimental diabetes in rats; chemical name 2-Deoxy-2-[(methylnitrosoamino)carbonyl]amino)-D-glucopyranose; attribution per Lenzen 2008a.

reviews.rationale: 引用 ENU/MNU 活性比较，没有具体细菌回复系统和活化；需原研究。
reviews.support_text: The introduction states that several investigators have compared the N-methyl and N-ethyl derivatives of N-nitrosourea (MNU and ENU) and have found ENU to be more mutagenic than MNU at equal survival levels [3-7], providing a cited-experiment basis for the mutagenicity of both MNU and ENU.
reviews.extra_details: Cited comparison [3-7] reporting ENU more mutagenic than MNU at equal survival levels; also cites bacteriophage/repair studies and estimates of 0.35 mutations per O-6-ethylguanine. Assay family and context not specified in this passage.

reviews.rationale: nitrosated cimetidine 产物自身未明确表征；不能把未确定产物的混合试验归给一个指定结构。
reviews.support_text: Short-term studies in vitro showed mutagenic activity in Salmonella typhimurium, E. coli, and Saccharomyces cerevisiae with nitrosated cimetidine (references 65-67). These nitrosation experiments reacted high concentrations of drug with excess nitrate in HCl, conditions the authors note are unlikely to be met in clinical use, and in none of the studies was there unequivocal characterization of the N-nitroso derivative generated by exposure to nitrite.
reviews.extra_details: Review synthesis of cited short-term in vitro studies (refs 65-67); nitrosation procedure generally involved reacting high concentrations of drug with excess nitrate in HCl, conditions the authors emphasize are unlikely to be met in clinical use.

reviews.decision: 本条不是可用的直接实验票
reviews.rationale: 光照下成纤维细胞突变，是不同细胞/暴露终点，不是 Ames。
reviews.support_text: The paper states that toluidine blue is expensive and has relatively toxic effects on fibroblasts, inducing mutagenesis of stained cells under high energy irradiation (reference 47 within the paper).
reviews.extra_details: Toluidine blue (tolonium chloride) also reported as expensive and hazardous if swallowed; mutagenic effect described as induction of mutagenesis in stained cells under high-energy irradiation.

reviews.rationale: Maillard 产物被引用为弱 mutagen；缺实验类型、菌株、活化和原始研究信息。
reviews.support_text: Spingarn and Garvie [4] isolated mutagenic 2-methylpyrazine from D-glucose-NH3, identified among weak mutagens formed via the Maillard reaction.
reviews.extra_details: Designated mutagenic in the Maillard reaction; isolated from D-glucose-NH3 (reference [4]); no specific assay family given.

reviews.decision: 本条不是可用的直接实验票
reviews.rationale: 真核回复突变及剂量依赖的突变谱比较，不是当前 Ames 目标。
reviews.support_text: The ratio of the reversion frequencies obtained with ICR-170 in mutants that revert by a base-pair insertion or deletion and those obtained in mutants that revert by another mechanism decreases with increasing dose of ICR-170. This means that the specificity of ICR-170 to induce base-pair insertions and deletions decreases with increasing dose and that the specificity for this particular genetic activity is most pronounced at a high level of survival.
reviews.extra_details: Dose-dependent specificity: the ratio of frameshift (insertion/deletion) revertants to base-pair substitution revertants falls with increasing ICR-170 dose; frameshift specificity is strongest at high survival (low dose). The relative frequency of the two activities can only be determined in a forward-mutation experiment, which the paper states is in progress.

reviews.support_text: E. coli FX-11 cells treated with 30 mM ENU (without genistein) showed a surviving fraction of 0.55±0.08 and an overall mutation frequency of 94±8.2×10^-6, with a backmutation frequency of 68±4.4×10^-6, consisting of both transition (CAA, TAG) and transversion (GAA, TCA, TAC, AAA, TTA, TAT) backmutations at the tyrA locus, plus GlnU0/GlnV0 tRNA suppressor mutations. Treatment with ENU alone is thus reported as inducing gene mutation in this bacterial reversion assay.
reviews.extra_details: ENU used as the inducing mutagen, with genistein tested as an antimutagen. At 30 mM ENU (no genistein) mutation frequency was 94±8.2×10^-6 (surviving fraction 0.55±0.08); in a parallel set, 30 mM ENU gave 89±5.7×10^-6. Backmutation frequency was 6.8×10^-5 (≈76% of total), composed of transitions (CAA, TAG) and transversions (GAA, TCA, TAC, AAA, TTA, TAT). Additional GlnU0/GlnV0 tRNA suppressor mutations arise from G:C to A:T transitions. At 20 mM ENU, mutation frequency was about 5.5×10^-5 in the absence of genistein. Antimutagenicity context: genistein reduced transition mutations ~1.9-fold and transversions ~8.5-fold; base changes determined by DNA sequence analysis; exposure in A-0 buffer with plating on semi-enriched agar.

reviews.rationale: 从引用的 eugenol 抑制关系推断 MNNG 阳性，缺本分子原始独立臂与条件。

reviews.extra_details: Mutagenic agent used to demonstrate eugenol's antimutagenicity; eugenol inhibited its mutagenicity in the Ames test. Also known as MNNG.

This record is provided only as context: Ames/Salmonella reverse-mutation results are EXCLUDED from the eligible fixed-mutation/chromosome endpoint extraction per task rules, so this does not form an included data record.

reviews.rationale: I2 complex 可能被错误映射为元素碘 II，需结构图和原研究核验；micronucleus positive 不能代替最大 MI1.75 的 Ames 判读。
reviews.support_text: The I2 complex significantly increased the frequency of micronuclei (MNs) at the two highest tested concentrations (50 µg/mL and 100 µg/mL) in the micronucleus-cytome assay, showing a genotoxic effect. This was additional to an increase in DNA migration by comet assay and an increase in revertant colonies in the TA97a strain after S9 (Ames test).
reviews.extra_details: Micronucleus-cytome assay measuring micronucleus (MN) frequency in HepG2 cells. The same study also reported increased DNA migration (comet assay) at the highest concentration (50 µg/mL) and increased TA97a revertant colonies with S9 (Ames test, maximum MI 1.75), both excluded as non-eligible endpoints. Statistical significance reported relative to the negative control.

reviews.rationale: 多研究 Salmonella 阴性汇总且用大鼠/仓鼠活化；需要原研究、完整 panel，不能从 result_call 直接建一票。
reviews.support_text: In bacteria, several studies with different Salmonella typhimurium strains in the presence and absence of exogenous metabolic activation systems from rat or hamster liver found no mutagenic effect when tested up to cytotoxic doses. A minimal, non-dose-dependent increase in revertants in a test with strains TA102 and TA104 in the absence of exogenous metabolic activation could not be confirmed in a further test with these strains.
reviews.extra_details: Studies performed with and without exogenous metabolic activation systems derived from rat or hamster liver, tested up to cytotoxic dose ranges. A minimal non-dose-dependent revertant increase in strains TA102 and TA104 without exogenous activation was not reproducible in a further test.

reviews.rationale: sotalol 有明确四株 Ames 阴性，但仅提到制备 S9，未清楚说明本结果对应 +S9/-S9/两者；需核实原方法/表格和身份。
reviews.support_text: Sotalol was tested for mutagenic activity. In the Ames test with S. typhimurium strains TA 98, TA 100, TA 1535, and TA 1537 there was no significant dose-dependent increase in histidine revertants. The same authors also tested sotalol in the micronucleus test using adult CF1 outbred mice; doses of 50, 100, and 150 mg/kg failed to produce a dose-related increase in the number of micronuclei. It was concluded from this study that the beta blockers tested, including sotalol, exhibited no evidence for mutagenic potential.
reviews.extra_details: Micronucleus test in adult CF1 outbred mice; sotalol administered at 50, 100, and 150 mg/kg failed to produce a dose-related increase in micronuclei. Authors concluded the beta blockers tested, including sotalol, exhibited no evidence for mutagenic potential. (The companion Ames/Salmonella reverse-mutation portion of the same study is excluded by task criteria; an activating system was prepared from livers of male Wistar rats pretreated with Aroclor 1254 and sotalol was tested at 1 to 1000 µg/plate.); compound_name: Sotalol

reviews.rationale: valepotriates/metabolites 与毒性混写，TA100 倍增不能自动归给一个 valtrate 结构；需逐化合物处理臂和可评价剂量。
reviews.support_text: The valepotriates as epoxides developed mutagenic and cytotoxic effects in the presence of S9 mix. While the genotoxic effect of the emerged metabolites was shown with the strain TA100 by the doubling of the spontaneous revertant numbers, because of the cytotoxicity, this effect is more obvious with the SOS-chromotest.
reviews.extra_details: Valtrate (VAL), as an epoxide, developed mutagenic and cytotoxic effects in the presence of S9 mix; the genotoxic effect of the emerged metabolites was more obvious in the SOS-chromotest because of cytotoxicity in the Ames TA100 assay. Metabolic activation source: S9 mix. No dose, sampling time, or response magnitude reported. Genotoxicity comparison with TA100 revertant doubling (Ames, excluded endpoint). Activation of VAL depends on ester hydrolysis by esterases.

reviews.decision: 本条不是可用的直接实验票
reviews.rationale: Allixin 是保护剂，回复突变归属于 AFB1；不能把抑制写成 Allixin 自身阴性。
reviews.support_text: Allixin, a phytoalexin isolated from garlic, showed a dose-related inhibition of His+ revertants induced by aflatoxin B1 (AFB1) in Salmonella typhimurium TA100 with rat liver S9 metabolic activation. Allixin at 75 µg/ml inhibited [3H]AFB1 binding to calf thymus DNA and reduced the formation of AFB1-DNA adducts. Allixin also concentration-dependently inhibited formation of organosoluble metabolites and glutathione conjugates of [3H]AFB1.
reviews.extra_details: challenge_or_cotreatment: aflatoxin B1 (AFB1, SMILES:10830875); allixin evaluated as protective/modifying agent reducing AFB1 binding and adduct formation; proposed mechanism is inhibition of microsomal P-450 enzymes leading to reduced AFB1 bioactivation; the associated His+ revertant data reflect the excluded Ames test and are not part of this record; negative_control/positive_control and exact assay-version details for the binding assay are not present in the supplied text window.

reviews.rationale: Luteolin 的明确四株 ±S9 阴性来自 Czeczot1990；可恢复但需原 PMID 和身份，不能使用当前 review PMID 加票。
reviews.support_text: Luteolin applied separately did not show increased His+ revertants in Salmonella typhimurium strains TA97, TA98, TA100, TA102 with or without metabolic activation (Czeczot et al., 1990; Ames-type test). However, in the E. coli K-12 strain PQ 37 it weakly induced the SOS system (Czeczot and Bilbin, 1991; Czeczot and Kusztelak, 1993).
reviews.extra_details: evidence_source: prior-study results clearly attributed to Czeczot and Bilbin (1991) and Czeczot and Kusztelak (1993). Agent applied separately (not as CCE/extract). Outcome described as weak induction. Luteolin did not increase His+ revertants in S. typhimurium (Ames test; excluded from this extraction). No dose, activation, positivity, or controls reported for the SOS endpoint.

reviews.rationale: PhIP 同条同时声称 revertants increased 和 TA1978 no revertants；需要原表解开菌株/臂归属，不能以 adduct positive 替代。
reviews.support_text: DNA adducts in Salmonella TA1978 were detected at an RAL of 21×10⁻⁷ adducts/nucleotide for 1116 µM PhIP. Increasing the S9 mix 5-fold in the incubation medium gave no increase in adduct formation, although revertant formation increased.
reviews.extra_details: S9 mix present in incubation medium; ~90 min preincubation; a 5-fold increase in S9 mix produced no increase in adduct formation (an increase in revertants was observed); no revertants in TA1978 overall, so adduct level could not be correlated with revertant formation.

reviews.rationale: 7-bromomethylbenz[a]anthracene 的 WP2uvrA 有剂量相关 reversion 描述；缺活化和身份，需原方法。
reviews.support_text: The authors connect the induction of Trp+ revertants in WP2uvrA to the extent of benz[a]anthracenyl-7-methyl residues bound to DNA and other macromolecules, reaffirming that the mutagen binds covalently to DNA in E. coli and that this binding is proportional to dose.
reviews.extra_details: DNA binding of 7-bromomethylbenz[a]anthracene stated to be proportional to dose; the attendant Trp+ revertant induction (a mutation endpoint, excluded) is described as proportional to dose and to benz[a]anthracenyl-7-methyl residues bound to DNA. WP2 data presented as insufficiently accurate to assess dose-mutagenesis relationship quantitatively. Method, dosing, and controls not given in this window.

reviews.rationale: paraquat 的 direct reversion endpoint 明确，但片段只有方法和 frequencies 的提及，没有二元结果/活化；适合作为结果页查找线索。
reviews.support_text: The paper reports paraquat (PQ2+) mutagenicity in Salmonella typhimurium tester strains TA98 and TA100 measured as His+ revertant frequencies per 10^8 CFU in solid minimal medium, the spot assay, and a modified liquid incubation assay. All endpoints are reversion of base-pair substitution and frameshift mutations scored on selection plates with or without limited histidine.

reviews.rationale: 正文 NDMA 是二甲基亚硝胺，SMILES 是带芳环的 nitroso dimethylaniline；明确主体-结构矛盾，不能投票或不经核验继续当同一分子证据。
reviews.support_text: Formaldehyde was assayed after a 1 h incubation of 2 mM NDMA with hamster liver S-9 mix, and 40 µM formaldehyde was recovered. The authors used this to argue that this concentration of formaldehyde induces <5% of the number of revertants in TA104 as a 2 mM solution of NDMA under the same conditions, i.e. formaldehyde is not responsible for NDMA's mutagenic effects.
reviews.extra_details: NDMA metabolite formation (formaldehyde) as a marker of the bioactivation pathway; authors interpret that 40 µM formaldehyde alone induces <5% of TA104 revertants compared to 2 mM NDMA, so formaldehyde is not the mutagenic species.

reviews.rationale: 正文 DCVC 的活化与 beta-lyase，SMILES 却无氯无硫的 dibutylcarbamate；主体-结构矛盾，需结构/名称核实。
reviews.support_text: In the present study, antioxidants such as AOAA and cyanidol did not decrease the number of revertants induced by DCVC in the Ames test. However, GSH appears to be involved in the activation of DCVC in the renal cortex since GSH increased the formation of DNA single-strand breaks and increased DNA repair only when the renal cortex S-9 mix was used. The authors propose that DCVC-derived reactive species form after conjugation of DCVC with GSH, processing of these conjugates by renal dipeptidases and activation by renal β-lyase, and that the reactive intermediates react with DNA to induce DNA damage and mutagenicity.
reviews.extra_details: Discussion-section summary of the activating role of GSH via conjugation, renal dipeptidase processing and renal beta-lyase activation. The experiments with AOAA and cyanidol antioxidants were performed in the Ames test and are therefore excluded. Secondary-citation provenance: assay systems and methods are described elsewhere in the paper, not in this window.

reviews.rationale: CH2Br2 在外加 GSTT1/GSH 下 TA1535 无回复增加是可恢复的条件化结果；但 PMID11018744 是综述，须追原研究并保留外加酶条件。
reviews.support_text: When CH2Br2 was tested exposing the parental strain TA1535 to purified rat enzyme GSTT1 and GSH, formaldehyde was produced but no increase of revertant frequency was observed, consistent with the view that activation of dihalomethanes must occur inside the bacteria and that formaldehyde formation itself is not enough to cause genetic damage.
reviews.extra_details: Formaldehyde was produced but no increase of revertant frequency was observed; text interprets that formaldehyde formation is not sufficient for genetic damage. The Ames/revertant endpoint is excluded per task instructions; only the independent formaldehyde-formation endpoint is recorded.

reviews.rationale: trenbolone 有低剂量阳性和 S9 消除描述；需菌株、毒性/溶解度、同位素身份及各剂量臂，不能统一成简单 no_effect。
reviews.support_text: Trenbolone (Tb), an anabolic steroid hormone analog, was irreversibly bound to DNA isolated from Salmonella after incubation of the bacteria with [³H]Tb. Because S9 eliminated the (Ames) mutagenicity while low doses increased revertants, covalent DNA binding is proposed as the mechanism of trenbolone mutagenicity. The authors caution that bactericidal or sparingly soluble compounds giving negative Ames results at high doses should be evaluated at low doses.
reviews.extra_details: Outside the scoped endpoint, the same study reports Ames/revertant results (relative mutagenicities 1.2-1.3 at 30-60 ug/plate, abolished by S9, with reduced survival at higher doses); those revertant measurements are excluded per task rules. Covalent DNA binding is proposed as the enabling mechanism of mutagenicity.

reviews.decision: 现有条件下的投票审核候选
reviews.rationale: MNUA 在 WP2 与 WP2 lexA 都诱发回复突变；no_effect 是 lexA 改变不影响作用，不能映射 negative。可提出 WP2/-S9 positive 候选；lexA 臂保留独立基因型，身份及方法仍待审核。
reviews.support_text: MNUA induced a similar number of revertants in E. coli WP2 lexA as in WP2, indicating that MNUA mutagenicity does not depend on the lexA gene product.
reviews.extra_details: MNUA induced a similar number of revertants in WP2 lexA as in WP2, i.e., MNUA mutagenicity is lexA/SOS-independent. MNUA is mapped to N-methyl-N-nitrosourea (SMILES:8635137); an alternate entity N-nitrosomethylurea (SMILES:17558897) also carries the MNUA surface form. Bacterial reversion readout whose design directly varies a DNA-repair mechanism; included under the repair-deficient/proficient exception. Dose values only in figures; no numeric concentrations/units in text.
reviews.remaining_requirements: Validate source-name mapping to N-methyl-N-nitrosourea and -S9 method; extract the WP2 self-outcome separately from lexA comparison. Do not map no_effect to Y=0.

reviews.decision: 本条不是可用的直接实验票
reviews.rationale: Tannic acid 降低 UV-induced revertants 属于抗突变修饰，不是其自身 Ames negative。
reviews.support_text: Tannic acid showed a bio-antimutagenic effect on UV-induced mutagenesis only in the repair-proficient strain E. coli B/r WP2 (uvr⁺); the number of Trp⁺ revertant colonies decreased as the tannic acid concentration increased, with an 80% decrease at 1 mg/plate, whereas little or no decrease was observed in the excision-repair-deficient strains WP2s (uvrA⁻) and ZA159 (uvrB⁻) under conditions where no cellular toxicity was observed. UV doses were 22.5 J/m² for WP2 and 2 J/m² for WP2s and ZA159.
reviews.extra_details: At 1 mg/plate tannic acid reduced Trp⁺ revertants by 80% in repair-proficient WP2 but little if any in excision-repair-deficient WP2s and ZA159; explicitly no cellular toxicity observed under the test conditions. Each point is the average of duplicate plates.
